references.text: Describes the priests' portion of the offerings, including the heave offering (terumah) that belongs to the priest
The heave offering of the holy gifts from the children of Israel is given to Aaron and his sons
Describes how the priest sprinkles the blood of the peace offering around on the altar
Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood of the peace offering around on the altar
Specifies that the right shoulder and breast of the peace offering shall be given to the priest as his portion
The heave offering and the wave offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right
The priests' rightful share of the offerings from the people
